messages:
incident-bot: Alert: high 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Pager -> maya (oncall). auto-detect policy '5xx-spike'.
maya (oncall): ack. I'm on it, starting triage.
maya (oncall): quick query — 5xxs are mostly 502/504 gateway from upstream inference-proxy, not internal OOMs. rolling 1m spike then sustained for ~6m.
josh (sre): fyi I've seen similar pattern earlier today on canary; upstream provider latency > 2s -> gateway timeouts. Could be overloaded model pool.
lena (platform): traffic routing shows ~30% of requests routed to fallback-model-v2 in us-west due to hot partition. That might be causing head-of-line delays.
maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable fast-fail circuit to avoid retries hitting upstream 2) shift % traffic away from affected pool -> route policy change 3) scale dedicated pool if capacity available. Doing step 1 now.
maya (oncall): enabled circuit-breaker for upstream pool `inference-edge-usw-1`. Reduced retry count to 0.
paul (prod-eng): can we flip routing to model-variant-cold to relieve hot node? I can push route override.
maya (oncall): @paul go ahead, start with 20% then ramp.
paul (prod-eng): done. route override to move 25% of traffic away. metrics show 5xx rate dropping after ~30s. :thumbsup:
eva (support): got multiple customer reports about timeouts in integrations, raising priority on support side and notifying key accounts.
josh (sre): good. parallel follow-up: we should avoid noisy pagers for short-lived upstream blips. Proposal: change alert window from 1m to 5m and require sustained rate > 10 errors/min for 3m before paging.
lena (platform): also add a suppression for bursts caused by autoscaling events — seen a lot when a pool spins up. We can add `for: 3m` and an annotation linking to the runbook.
maya (oncall): agree. For now manual action: lowered paging threshold in oncall route to alert only if sustained >3m. I'll open a ticket to tune permanently.
paul (prod-eng): can someone create a dashboard with these panels: 5xx rate by route, upstream latency by pool, retry counts, routing splits. Should help future triage.
josh (sre): I'll create a quick graf panel and pin it to eng-oncall. Code for suggested alert (example):
```
alert: high_5xx_rate_generate_usw
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status=~"5..",region="us-west-2"}[5m])) > 10
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-gateway
```
josh (sre): note the change: use 5m scrape + 3m for commit to reduce paging for short bursts.
maya (oncall): created SR ticket RW-INC-2026-457 and assigned to josh/lena for post-incident tuning. I'll mark incident status as mitigated — customer impact reduced because we routed traffic and enabled fast-fail.
eva (support): thanks — sending a customer update to affected accounts with ETA for RCA.
lena (platform): follow-ups: 1) add dashboard panels (josh) 2) update alert rule and add suppression 3) add runbook step to prefer route override 4) test circuit-breaker behavior in staging.
josh (sre): will send a PR to alerting repo with the new expr and `for: 3m`. I'll include rollback steps.
maya (oncall): nice work team. I'll hand off long-running postmortem to josh/lena. Oncall returning to normal. :white_check_mark:
